text: Sorry if this is a daft one. My grandson is 8 and he's been tugging at his left ear all evening, says it hurts. Temp was 38 I think, maybe just over. His eczema's playing up again too, dry itchy patches on his arms and behind his knees, he's been scratching them raw. I read about pressing a glass on any rash so I did that and the red bits go white under it, so I'm assuming that's ok? Not sure if I'm worrying over nothing. His mum normally deals with this sort of thing.
